codex.label: Codex
codex.description: Install the native Skill and configure Codex's Streamable HTTP MCP connection.
codex.prompt:
Configure CarbonPaper local-memory access in Codex.

1. Fetch the {{skillName}} directory from {{repo}} and install it as a Codex Skill. It targets tool contract v{{toolSchemaVersion}}.
2. Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server named carbonpaper with URL {{endpoint}}.
3. Configure the header Authorization: Bearer <CarbonPaper token>. Do not put the token in prompts or logs; ask me to use Copy token in CarbonPaper and store it in Codex's local secret configuration.
4. Use the Skill for screenshot history, OCR, task-cluster, and smart-cluster summary requests. search_nl is Chinese-CLIP text-to-image visual retrieval, not a Python-only feature.
5. tools/list is a stable contract; temporary readiness comes from CarbonPaper diagnostics and call results. If a call returns AUTH_REQUIRED, tell me to unlock CarbonPaper with Windows Hello.
6. Read only local data needed for my explicit request. When finished, report the configuration location and connection-test result.

claude.label: Claude
claude.description: Configure Claude Desktop or Claude Code and use the Skill documents as project guidance.
claude.prompt:
Configure CarbonPaper local-memory access for Claude Desktop or Claude Code.

1. Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server named carbonpaper with URL {{endpoint}}.
2. Configure Authorization: Bearer <CarbonPaper token>. Do not put the token in chat, project instructions, or logs; ask me to copy it separately from CarbonPaper and store it in the client's local secret configuration.
3. Read {{skillName}}/SKILL.md and its references from {{repo}} as the CarbonPaper workflow guide. The current tool contract is v{{toolSchemaVersion}}.
4. search_nl is Chinese-CLIP text-to-image visual retrieval and must not be described as Python-dependent. tools/list always exposes the static contract; temporary readiness is reported when a tool is called.
5. If a call returns AUTH_REQUIRED, tell me to unlock CarbonPaper with Windows Hello.
6. Read only data needed for my explicit request. Report the configuration location and connection-test result when done.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Configure Cursor MCP and add the Skill workflow to local project rules or Agent context.
cursor.prompt:
Configure CarbonPaper local-memory access in Cursor.

1. Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server named carbonpaper with URL {{endpoint}}.
2. Configure Authorization: Bearer <CarbonPaper token>. Do not put the token in chat, repository files, or committed rules; ask me to copy it separately from CarbonPaper and store it in Cursor's private local configuration.
3. Read {{skillName}}/SKILL.md and its references from {{repo}}, then add the applicable workflow to local Agent context. The tool contract is v{{toolSchemaVersion}}.
4. search_nl is Chinese-CLIP visual retrieval, not a Python-only path. tools/list is static and temporary backend unavailability is a call-time result.
5. On AUTH_REQUIRED, tell me to unlock CarbonPaper with Windows Hello.
6. Report the configuration location and MCP connection-test result without printing the token.

generic.label: Generic
generic.description: For other Agents that support Streamable HTTP MCP.
generic.prompt:
Configure local CarbonPaper MCP access.

1. Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server named carbonpaper at {{endpoint}}.
2. Use Authorization: Bearer <CarbonPaper token>. Do not place the token in prompts, logs, or repositories; ask me to copy it separately from CarbonPaper and store it in the client's local secret configuration.
3. Read the workflow in the {{skillName}} directory at {{repo}}. The current tool contract is v{{toolSchemaVersion}}.
4. search_nl is Chinese-CLIP text-to-image visual retrieval. tools/list is a static contract; live readiness is a call-time result.
5. If a call returns AUTH_REQUIRED, tell me to unlock CarbonPaper with Windows Hello.
6. Read only data needed for explicit requests, then validate the setup with ping, tools/list, and a read-only query.

clipBackfill.failedImports: {{count}} vectors could not be read. See the migration diagnostics for details.
clipBackfill.whenItRuns: The backfill only runs while the computer is idle and on mains power, so it will not interrupt what you are doing. You can speed it up or stop it under Settings → Advanced at any time, and you can change your mind later.
clipBackfill.cardPending: {{count}} screenshots have no image index. A backfill would take {{estimate}}.
clipBackfill.cardApproved: Backfill allowed; it will finish gradually while the computer is idle.
clipBackfill.cardDeclined: Backfill declined. Missing vectors will not be automatically recalculated.

minilm.title: Migrating the text index
minilm.subtitle: Screenshot-text vectors are being moved into the local Rust index. The app is in maintenance mode while this runs.

clip.title: Migrating the image index
clip.subtitle: Screenshot-image vectors are being moved into the local Rust index. The app is in maintenance mode while this runs.

unknown.title: Maintenance in progress
unknown.subtitle: The app is running a maintenance task. Some features stay unavailable until it finishes.

vectorMigration.safeWrite: Writing to disk. Please do not force-quit the app.
vectorMigration.waitingForAuth: Your session has expired. Complete Windows Hello authentication and the migration will continue automatically.
vectorMigration.errorCount: {{count}} records could not be migrated. Details were written to the migration diagnostics.
vectorMigration.blockedHint: Other operations are unavailable during migration. If the app exits, migration resumes after the next launch and unlock.

securityAlert.title: Monitor integrity compromised
securityAlert.default_message: A required monitor component failed its integrity check. Startup has been blocked to protect your data.
securityAlert.recovery_hint: If you did not install or update CarbonPaper yourself, please reinstall from a trusted source. A log entry has been written to security.log under your CarbonPaper AppData directory.

ocrModelRepair.title: OCR Model Repair
ocrModelRepair.readyDescription: New screenshots will resume generating OCR text.
ocrModelRepair.description: CarbonPaper will continue saving screenshots safely, but no OCR text will be generated until the model is repaired. It will not fall back to JPEG or Python OCR.
ocrModelRepair.noAuth: Repair does not require unlocking or Windows Hello verification. Downloads are checked for size and SHA-256, and the new model loads automatically on the next OCR request.
